fields.description: The address this request was sent to, frozen at send. The signer must re-type this to sign — a later edit to the contract's Contact Email must not change who can execute a link already in flight.
fields.label: Sent To

fields.description: The contract revision this request was raised against.
fields.label: Contract Revision

fields.description: Frozen at send. Every later operation reads this, never the current Settings value — changing the provider must not orphan links already in flight.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: Set when a resend issued a fresh link; this row's link no longer works.
fields.label: Superseded By

fields.description: SHA-256 of the signing token. The token itself is never stored — it exists only in the email we sent. Possession of it plus the address above executes the contract, so a database copy must not carry it.
fields.label: Token Hash

fields.description: SHA-256 of the link this one replaced. Kept so a customer who opens an older email is told their link was superseded, rather than being shown a dead end.
fields.label: Previous Token Hash

fields.description: External identifier when a third-party signature provider is used (e.g. a DocuSign envelope id). Blank for In-House.
fields.label: Provider Reference

fields.description: The name the signer adopted as their signature. In Typed mode this IS the signature.
fields.label: Signed Name

fields.description: The signing moment in UTC. Recorded alongside the site-local stamp because a site-local time with no recorded zone is ambiguous the moment System Settings changes.
fields.label: Signed At (UTC)

fields.description: The drawn signature, when the signer drew one.
fields.label: Signature Image

fields.description: The signer re-typed the address this was sent to.
fields.label: Email Confirmed

fields.description: UNTRUSTED — taken from the X-Forwarded-For header, which the caller controls. Recorded for correlation only and never used as a security decision on its own. Compare against the peer address beside it.
fields.label: Signer IP (claimed)

fields.description: The TCP peer address the request actually arrived from.
fields.label: Signer IP (peer)

fields.description: "Unavailable" means Cloudflare could not be reached. The signature is still accepted — the signer already held a single-use link sent to a known address — but it is flagged here and in the staff alert.
fields.label: Turnstile Verdict

fields.description: Seconds between opening the agreement and signing it.
fields.label: Review Seconds

fields.description: UNTRUSTED — asserted by the signer's browser. Indicative only.
fields.label: Scrolled To End

fields.description: Fingerprint of the exact consent text the signer agreed to.
fields.label: Consent Version

fields.description: The E-SIGN consumer disclosure in force when this was signed.
fields.label: Electronic Records Disclosure
Agreement Snapshot (proof of what was signed)

fields.description: Full SHA-256 of the agreement HTML that was displayed to the signer.
fields.label: Document Hash

fields.description: SHA-256 of the Contract Template body in force when this was sent.
fields.label: Template Body Hash

fields.description: The agreement re-rendered differently at signing than when it was sent — the template or a contract field changed while the link was out. The signature still stands (the snapshot below is what the customer saw and agreed to); this flags it for a human to look at.
fields.label: Document Drifted

fields.description: The exact agreement HTML the signer was shown, captured when the request was sent (signature lines still blank, as displayed).
fields.label: Document Snapshot

fields.description: Full SHA-256 of the executed agreement below.
fields.label: Agreement Hash

fields.description: The executed instrument: the agreement re-rendered with the signature in place, plus the completion certificate. This — not a live re-render — is what the customer receives, what is attached to the contract, and what the desk print shows.
fields.label: Executed Agreement

fields.description: When the customer's executed copy was emailed. Blank on a signed request means delivery has not landed yet; the daily sweep retries it.
fields.label: Copy Delivered On

fields.description: When the team was told about this signature. Separate from the delivery stamp so the daily retry sweep cannot re-alert them each time the customer's copy fails to send.
fields.label: Staff Notified On

fields.description: How many times someone has entered an email address on the signing page for this request. Persisted rather than kept only in the cache, because a cache flush (every deploy) would otherwise reset the lifetime guess limit and the lockout would never fire. Reset to zero when staff re-send the link, which is what gives a locked-out customer another try.
fields.label: Email Confirmation Attempts
